business_problem: Zhenyun Technology needed to reduce the friction of procurement support inside its SRM platform. Users had to dig through documents for purchasing information, repetitive questions still consumed human service teams, many issues arrived outside business hours, and procurement knowledge was hard to preserve and reuse during onboarding and day-to-day operations.
solution_summary: Zhenyun Technology embedded Alibaba Cloud's intelligent dialogue robot into its procurement digital-management platform so buyer and supplier questions could be answered inside the SRM workflow rather than through manuals or human support queues. The implementation starts with a dedicated procurement knowledge base built on business documents and process information, giving users one place to retrieve policy, order, and system knowledge. The dialogue robot is then integrated with the document and order system so users can ask questions conversationally while working, and the assistant can map requests to the relevant procurement context instead of returning generic FAQ snippets. Because the platform is always online, the architecture supports 7x24 automated consultation, lower training burden for new users, and future transaction-assistant workflows for repetitive low-value procurement tasks. This turns the bot from a standalone help feature into an in-workflow procurement copilot.

solution_components.role: Provides always-on conversational support for procurement questions inside the SRM platform.

solution_components.role: Stores procurement documents and process knowledge so users can retrieve accurate answers quickly.

solution_components.name: procurement intelligent assistant
solution_components.role: Connects the dialogue robot and knowledge base to procurement document and workflow context in the SRM system.

data_flow: Procurement documents and process information are indexed into a dedicated knowledge base, then exposed through an intelligent dialogue robot embedded inside the SRM workflow. User questions are interpreted against the current procurement context and answered in the platform, with the same foundation supporting future transaction-assistant automation.
business_outcome: Zhenyun improved procurement collaboration and system usability without scaling its support headcount linearly. The AI assistant gives users immediate answers, reduces repetitive manual support work, lowers onboarding and knowledge-transfer costs, and lets procurement staff focus more on higher-value tasks instead of repeatedly handling the same questions.
architecture_clues: The assistant is integrated into procurement documents and SRM workflows rather than operating as a separate help portal.
A dedicated procurement knowledge base underpins the dialogue robot so answers can be tied to business context.
The same architecture is intended to expand from FAQ automation into transaction-assistant workflows for repetitive procurement work.
